basic_info.description: Facing the green and tranquil Scott St Labyrinth, this meticulously maintained 2-unit Victorian has no monthly HOA dues. The expansive 2 bed + den condo blends preserved period details with modern updates. Soaring 11 foot ceilings, hardwood floors, glass french doors and molding frame the home's ideal layout. The east-facing living room features built-in bookshelves, fireplace and large bay window with views of the city skyline, Labyrinth and pathway to Duboce Park, playground & dog play area. Two spacious bedrooms are conveniently located near the full bath with radiant heated floors and a dual-head walk-in shower. The versatile den works as an office or entertaining space. Ask about converting it to a legal third bedroom. Off the newly remodeled kitchen is a washer/dryer closet, pantry and window-wrapped dining area that opens to the shared garden and massive deeded deck. The garage level features a large storage room, two additional storage areas and a straight in parking space, all deeded. Another full bath is also located in the garage. With a 97 Walk Score, you're steps from Duboce Park, tech shuttles, Muni, cafes, restaurants and more!
